text: The system shall publish an instrument-health state at least once every 5 seconds.
The system shall flag detector measurements outside configured operating limits.
The system shall retain observation and diagnostic records for at least 30 days.
The health processor shall calculate each health state within 4 seconds.
The measurement validator shall reject nonnumeric detector measurements before processing.
The record store shall preserve timestamps, observation identifiers, health states, and diagnostic flags.
